mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages_raw (message_key, device_id, imei, message_code, process_dttm, latitude, longitude, raw_payload, status, received_at) VALUES (#{messageKey}, #{deviceId}, #{imei}, #{messageCode}, #{processDttm}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{rawPayload}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT (message_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id
